title: Integer formula for the transformed coefficient
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and encode each input and output sign as a bit, with $+1$ encoded by $0$ and $-1$ by $1$. For every subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the transformed Fourier coefficient of the real-valued sign function associated to $f$ equals the integer, viewed as a real number, $\displaystyle\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\mathbf{1}\{f(\mathbf{1}_T)=1\}$, where $\mathbf{1}_T$ is the bit vector equal to $1$ on $T$ and $0$ elsewhere, and the condition uses the bit encoding of $f$'s output.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
